data.title: A water network that finds its own losses
data.summary: A regional water utility connected pump stations and district meters to cut restoration time and technical losses.
data.challenge: Operators learned about failures from customer calls. District losses were estimated annually, and pump stations used inconsistent telemetry.
data.strategy: We defined a district metered area model and a common telemetry standard before adding sensors. The operations team helped choose the alarms that would actually change a night shift.
data.implementation: Thirty-eight stations were connected through a resilient telemetry layer with local buffering. Leak alarms were correlated with pressure and flow, and restoration procedures were rewritten around the new signals.
